title: 6.7.11a Fix the Broken Chart — Dragging a Sprite
description: Someone charted the grab half of drag-and-drop and never charted the letting go. Find what the red checks are pointing at.

diagram.starter:
flowchart TD
  A([draw() runs]) --> B{mouse.pressing()}
  B -- yes --> C{is the sprite under the mouse}
  C -- yes --> D[move sprite to the mouse]
  C -- no --> E([end of frame])
  D --> D
  F[set velocity to zero]
